I have farmed this small piece of land for many years. Maize grows better with some fertilizer, so I will buy a small amount of DAP and urea from the cooperative — not too much, because money is tight and the plot is only small. I will also spread some compost and manure I have gathered near the house. I will plant seed I kept from my own harvest last year; the new seed from the shop is too costly for me. We do not use chemicals or irrigation on this land — we depend on the rains. My family and I will do all the work ourselves over the season. It is a small plot, so about ten days of family labor will see it through, and we cannot afford to hire outside workers.
